entries.en: to say, to speak (same sense as the preceding entry)
entries.notes: M 栏 fā 与 R 栏 tān 不对应，H「咀」当是闽南语 tàⁿ（说）的俗用字，释义依 R 栏与“ut supra”定。

entries.zh: 唱经，诵经（举行唱经弥撒）
entries.en: to chant the Mass; to sing the office
entries.notes: H 栏「利譯」疑为「講經」之讹，L 栏“cantavel reco.”为缩略残文，义据 M/R 音写推断。

entries.zh: 浅说，浅显地讲述；浅显的说明
entries.en: to speak superficially; a plain, surface-level exposition
entries.notes: L 栏“exposito cla. clar.”为缩略写法，依 H「淺說」与西语“superficialmente”定。

entries.en: to assert flatly, to state outright
entries.notes: L 栏“& lemandan & calle”短语残缺，H、M、R 三栏亦不完全对应，确切义难以定夺。

entries.en: to disclose, to reveal; to speak out once aware
entries.notes: H 栏「竟」疑为「覺」，M 栏 câg 与「覺」kak 相合，R 栏 tā guīo 与 H 音不合。

entries.zh: 解开，松开；释放；解释，说明
entries.en: to untie, to loosen; to release, to set free; to declare, to explain
entries.notes: L 栏尾注“.y7.”为原稿残记，M 栏并列三读，取与 R 栏 guiày 相应之「解」。

entries.en: to release, to set free; to explain, to expound
entries.notes: R 栏 dŷe 与「釋」的官话对音不合，疑为原稿摹写之误，释义依 H/M 与 L 栏。

entries.en: what is said; a statement, an utterance
entries.notes: L 栏作“Declarar, soltar”（声明、松开），与 H「所說」的名词义有出入，从汉字栏定。

entries.en: the moon declining toward the west

entries.notes: L 栏“mui biejo”为“muy viejo”之讹写；M 栏 Láimǒ 当系「老耄」的合写。

entries.en: copper thimble; ornamental copper finger guard

entries.notes: L 栏“de Dedal de cuero p”句末截断，义据 H「皮指」与残文定。
